category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. ʿAlī Mājilawayh—may Allāh have mercy on him—narrated to us, saying that his paternal uncle Muḥammad b. Abī’l-Qāsim narrated to him, saying that Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Kūfī narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Sinān narrated to him among others, from al-Mufaḍḍal b. ʿUmar, from Yūnus b. Ẓibyān, who narrates: “I said to al-Ṣādiq (as): “What is it that distances Iblīs from us?” So he replied: “Fasting blackens his face, charity breaks his back, love for Allāh and mutual support in righteous deeds sever his lineage, and seeking forgiveness cuts his lifeline.”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن علي ماجيلويه (ره)، قال: حدثني عمي محمد بن أبي القاسم، قال: حدثنا محمد بن علي الكوفي، قال: حدثنا محمد بن سنان، عن المفضّل بن عمر، عن يونس بن ظبيان، قال: قلت للصادق (عليه السلام): ما الذي يباعد عنا إبليس؟ قال: الصوم يسود وجهه والصدقة تكسر ظهره والحب في الله والمؤازرة على العمل الصالح يقطعان دابره والاستغفار يقطع وتينه.
thaqalaynSanad: Muḥammad b. ʿAlī Mājilawayh—may Allāh have mercy on him—narrated to us, saying that his paternal uncle Muḥammad b. Abī’l-Qāsim narrated to him, saying that Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Kūfī narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Sinān narrated to him among others, from al-Mufaḍḍal b. ʿUmar, from Yūnus b. Ẓibyān, who narrates: “I said to al-Ṣādiq (as):
thaqalaynMatn: “What is it that distances Iblīs from us?” So he replied: “Fasting blackens his face, charity breaks his back, love for Allāh and mutual support in righteous deeds sever his lineage, and seeking forgiveness cuts his lifeline.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. Mūsā b. al-Mutawakkil narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Yaḥyā b. ʿImrān al-Ashʿarī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Rāzī narrated to him among others, from al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Abī Ḥamza, from Rafāʿa, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh (as), who narrates: “The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) has said: “Seek assistance for fasting during the day by having the pre-dawn meal and for the night prayer by getting some sleep beforehand.”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن موسى بن المتوكّل، قال: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى العطّار، قال: حدثنا محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الأشعري، قال: حدثنا أبو عبد الله الرازي، عن الحسن بن علي بن أبي حمزة، عن رفاعة، عن أبي عبد الله (عليه السلام)، قال: قال رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله): تعاونوا بأكل السحر على صيام النهار وبالنوم على الصلاة بالليل.
thaqalaynSanad: Muḥammad b. Mūsā b. al-Mutawakkil narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Yaḥyā b. ʿImrān al-Ashʿarī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū ʿAbd Allāh al-Rāzī narrated to him among others, from al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Abī Ḥamza, from Rafāʿa, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh (as), who narrates: “The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) has said:
thaqalaynMatn: “Seek assistance for fasting during the day by having the pre-dawn meal and for the night prayer by getting some sleep beforehand.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: My father (rh) narrated to us, saying that Saʿd b. ʿAbd Allāh narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥusayn b. Abī’l-Khaṭṭāb narrated to him among others, from Muḥammad b. Yaḥyā al-Khazzāz, from Ṭalḥa b. Zayd, from al-Ṣādiq, Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers (as-p), who have said: “Do not say “Ramaḍān” or that “Ramaḍān has come,” but rather say “The month of Ramaḍān,” for indeed you know not what Ramaḍān is.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبي رحمه الله، قال: حدثنا سعد بن عبد الله، قال: حدثنا محمد بن الحسن، قال: حدثنا محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطّاب، عن محمد بن يحيى الخزّاز، عن طلحة بن زيد، عن الصادق جعفر بن محمد، عن أبيه، عن آبائه (عليهم السلام)، قال: لا تقولوا رمضان ولا جاء رمضان، قولوا: شهر رمضان فإنكم لا تدرون ما رمضان.
thaqalaynSanad: My father (rh) narrated to us, saying that Saʿd b. ʿAbd Allāh narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥusayn b. Abī’l-Khaṭṭāb narrated to him among others, from Muḥammad b. Yaḥyā al-Khazzāz, from Ṭalḥa b. Zayd, from al-Ṣādiq, Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad, from his father, from his forefathers (as-p), who have said:
thaqalaynMatn: “Do not say “Ramaḍān” or that “Ramaḍān has come,” but rather say “The month of Ramaḍān,” for indeed you know not what Ramaḍān is.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan narrated to us, saying that Aḥmad b. Idrīs narrated to him among others, from Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Yaḥyā b. ʿImrān al-Ashʿarī, from Ibrāhīm b. Hāshim, from Mūsā b. ʿImrān al-Hamadānī, from Yūnus b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Yūnus b. ʿAmmār, who said: “I have heard Abā ʿAbd Allāh (as) saying: “Whoever (wilfully) breaks his fast (before its time) for a day in the month of Ramaḍān, he has broken faith (with Allāh).”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن الحسن، قال: حدثنا أحمد بن إدريس، عن محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الأشعري، عن إبراهيم بن هاشم، عن موسى بن عمران الهمداني، عن يونس بن عبد الرحمن، عن يونس بن عمار، قال: سمعت أبا عبد الله (عليه السلام) يقول: من أفطر يوماً من شهر رمضان خرج الإيمان منه.
thaqalaynSanad: Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan narrated to us, saying that Aḥmad b. Idrīs narrated to him among others, from Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Yaḥyā b. ʿImrān al-Ashʿarī, from Ibrāhīm b. Hāshim, from Mūsā b. ʿImrān al-Hamadānī, from Yūnus b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from Yūnus b. ʿAmmār, who said: “I have heard Abā ʿAbd Allāh (as) saying:
thaqalaynMatn: “Whoever (wilfully) breaks his fast (before its time) for a day in the month of Ramaḍān, he has broken faith (with Allāh).”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: My father (rh) narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār narrated to him among others, from Muḥammad b. Aḥmad, from Ibrāhīm b. Hāshim, from Ḥamza b. Yaʿlī, from Muḥammad b. al-Ḥusayn b. Abī Khālid, who raised it up to Abī ʿAbd Allāh (as) [the manuscripts differ], who said: “When you verify that the crescent moon of the month of Rajab has appeared, start counting for fifty-nine days, then fast on the sixtieth.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبي رحمه الله، قال: حدثنا محمد بن يحيى العطّار، عن محمد بن أحمد، عن إبراهيم بن هاشم، عن حمزة بن يعلي، عن محمد بن الحسين بن أبي خالد، رفعه إلى أبي عبد الله (عليه السلام) [و خ ل] قال: إذا صح هلال رجب فعد تسعة وخمسين يوماً وصم يوم ستين.
thaqalaynSanad: My father (rh) narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār narrated to him among others, from Muḥammad b. Aḥmad, from Ibrāhīm b. Hāshim, from Ḥamza b. Yaʿlī, from Muḥammad b. al-Ḥusayn b. Abī Khālid, who raised it up to Abī ʿAbd Allāh (as) [the manuscripts differ], who said:
thaqalaynMatn: “When you verify that the crescent moon of the month of Rajab has appeared, start counting for fifty-nine days, then fast on the sixtieth.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. ʿAlī Mājilūwayh narrated to us from his paternal uncle, Muḥammad b. Abī’l-Qāsim, from Aḥmad b. Abī ʿAbd Allāh, from his father, from Aḥmad b. Naṣr al-Kharrāz, [1] from ʿAmrū b. Shimr, from Jābir, from Abī Jaʿfar al-Bāqir (as), who narrates: “The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) has stated: “When the disk (of the sun) disappears, it is time for the one who fasted to break his fast, and for one to perform his prayers.”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن علي ماجيلويه، عن عمه محمد بن أبي القاسم، عن أحمد بن أبي عبد الله، عن أبيه، عن أحمد بن نصر الخرّاز، عن عمرو بن شمر، عن جابر، عن أبي جعفر الباقر (عليه السلام)، قال: قال رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله): إذا غاب القرص أفطر الصائم ودخل وقت الصلاة.
thaqalaynSanad: Muḥammad b. ʿAlī Mājilūwayh narrated to us from his paternal uncle, Muḥammad b. Abī’l-Qāsim, from Aḥmad b. Abī ʿAbd Allāh, from his father, from Aḥmad b. Naṣr al-Kharrāz, [1] from ʿAmrū b. Shimr, from Jābir, from Abī Jaʿfar al-Bāqir (as), who narrates: “The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) has stated:
thaqalaynMatn: “When the disk (of the sun) disappears, it is time for the one who fasted to break his fast, and for one to perform his prayers.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: My father (rh) narrated to us, saying that Saʿd b. ʿAbd Allāh narrated to him among others, saying that Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. ʿĪsā narrated to him among others, from ʿAlī b. al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd al-Mālik b. ʿUtba, from Isḥāq b. ʿAmmār, from Yaḥyā b. Abī’l-ʿAlī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh (as), who has stated: “The one who fasts in the month of Ramaḍān while traveling is like the one who has broken his fast at home.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبي رحمه الله، قال: حدثنا سعد بن عبد الله، قال: حدثنا أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى، عن علي بن الحكم، عن عبد الملك بن عتبة، عن إسحاق بن عمار، عن يحيى بن أبي العلي، عن أبي عبد الله (عليه السلام)، قال: الصائم في شهر رمضان في السفر كالمفطر فيه في الحضر.
thaqalaynSanad: My father (rh) narrated to us, saying that Saʿd b. ʿAbd Allāh narrated to him among others, saying that Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. ʿĪsā narrated to him among others, from ʿAlī b. al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd al-Mālik b. ʿUtba, from Isḥāq b. ʿAmmār, from Yaḥyā b. Abī’l-ʿAlī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh (as), who has stated:
thaqalaynMatn: “The one who fasts in the month of Ramaḍān while traveling is like the one who has broken his fast at home.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. ʿAlī (b.) Mājīlawayh narrated to us, saying that ʿAlī b. Ibrāhīm b. Hāshim narrated to him, from his father, from Muḥammad b. Abī ʿUmayr, from more than one person, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Ṣādiq (as), who has said: “The Messenger of Allāh (sws) has said: “The month of Ramaḍān is the month of Allāh (azwj), and it is the month in which Allāh doubles the rewards of good deeds and erases misdeeds. It is the month of blessing, the month of turning (to Allāh), the month of repentance, the month of forgiveness, the month of liberation from Perdition, and the month of triumph through Paradise. So beware of every forbidden thing in it, recite the Qurʾān abundantly, ask in it for your needs, and occupy yourselves in it with the remembrance of your Lord. Let not the month of Ramaḍān be with you like any other month, for it has with Allāh a sanctity and a distinction over all other months, and let not the day of your fasting in Ramaḍān be like the day of your breaking the fast.”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن علي ماجيلويه، قال: حدثني علي بن إبراهيم بن هاشم، عن أبيه، عن محمد بن أبي عمير، عن غير واحد، عن أبي عبد الله الصادق (عليه السلام)، قال: وقال رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم): شهر رمضان شهر الله عز وجل وهو شهر يضاعف الله فيه الحسنات ويمحو فيه السيئات وهو شهر البركة وهو شهر الإنابة وهو شهر التوبة وهو شهر المغفرة وهو شهر العتق من النار والفوز بالجنة ألا فاجتنبوا فيه كل حرام وأكثروا فيه من تلاوة القرآن وسلوا فيه حوائجكم واشتغلوا فيه بذكر ربكم ولا يكونن شهر رمضان عندكم كغيره من الشهور فإن له عند الله حرمة وفضلاً على سائر الشهور ولا يكونن شهر رمضان يوم صومكم كيوم فطركم.
thaqalaynSanad: Muḥammad b. ʿAlī (b.) Mājīlawayh narrated to us, saying that ʿAlī b. Ibrāhīm b. Hāshim narrated to him, from his father, from Muḥammad b. Abī ʿUmayr, from more than one person, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Ṣādiq (as), who has said: “The Messenger of Allāh (sws) has said:
thaqalaynMatn: “The month of Ramaḍān is the month of Allāh (azwj), and it is the month in which Allāh doubles the rewards of good deeds and erases misdeeds. It is the month of blessing, the month of turning (to Allāh), the month of repentance, the month of forgiveness, the month of liberation from Perdition, and the month of triumph through Paradise. So beware of every forbidden thing in it, recite the Qurʾān abundantly, ask in it for your needs, and occupy yourselves in it with the remembrance of your Lord. Let not the month of Ramaḍān be with you like any other month, for it has with Allāh a sanctity and a distinction over all other months, and let not the day of your fasting in Ramaḍān be like the day of your breaking the fast.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan b. al-Walīd (ra) narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥusayn b. Abī’l-Khaṭṭāb narrated to him among others, from al-Naḍr b. Shuʿayb, from ʿAbd al-Ghaffār al-Jāzī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh (as), who said: “Whoever is upon a matter without right and does not repent from it (while he can), he will not be forgiven in Shaʿbān or the month of Ramaḍān, and it will remain upon him until the following year.”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن الحسن بن الوليد رضي الله عنه، قال: حدثنا محمد بن الحسن الصفّار، قال: حدثنا محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطّاب، عن النضر بن شعيب، عن عبد الغفّار الجازي، عن أبي عبد الله (عليه السلام)، قال: من كان على أمر ليس بحق لم يتب منه لم يغفر له في شعبان وشهر رمضان لم يزل عليه إلى قابل.
thaqalaynSanad: Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan b. al-Walīd (ra) narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥusayn b. Abī’l-Khaṭṭāb narrated to him among others, from al-Naḍr b. Shuʿayb, from ʿAbd al-Ghaffār al-Jāzī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh (as), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: “Whoever is upon a matter without right and does not repent from it (while he can), he will not be forgiven in Shaʿbān or the month of Ramaḍān, and it will remain upon him until the following year.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm b. Isḥāq narrated to us, saying that Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Hamadānī narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAlī b. al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Faḍḍāl narrated to him among others, from his father, from Abī’l-Ḥasan ʿAlī b. Mūsā al-Riḍā (as), who said: “Whoever gives a loaf of bread in charity to a pauper at the time he is supposed to break his fast, Allāh will forgive him for his sins and record for him the reward of freeing a descendant of Ismāʿīl from the yoke of slavery.”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن إبراهيم بن إسحاق، قال: حدثنا أحمد بن محمد الهمداني، قال: حدثنا علي بن الحسن بن علي بن فضّال، عن أبيه، عن أبي الحسن علي بن موسى الرضا (عليه السلام)، قال: من تصدق وقت إفطاره على مسكين برغيف غفر الله له ذنبه وكتب له ثواب عتق رقبة من ولد إسماعيل.
thaqalaynSanad: Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm b. Isḥāq narrated to us, saying that Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Hamadānī narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAlī b. al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Faḍḍāl narrated to him among others, from his father, from Abī’l-Ḥasan ʿAlī b. Mūsā al-Riḍā (as), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: “Whoever gives a loaf of bread in charity to a pauper at the time he is supposed to break his fast, Allāh will forgive him for his sins and record for him the reward of freeing a descendant of Ismāʿīl from the yoke of slavery.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: And with the same chain of transmission, he (i.e., al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Faḍḍāl) has said that Imam al-Riḍā (as) has stated: “Whoever recites the following supplication at the time he breaks his fast—O’ Allāh, for You we fasted through Your grant of success and upon Your sustenance we broke our fast upon Your command, so accept it from us and forgive us. Indeed, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful—Allāh will forgive him for what loss his fasting has incurred as a result of his sins.”
arabicText: وبهذا الإسناد، قال: قال الرضا (عليه السلام): من قال عند إفطاره « اللهم لك صمنا بتوفيقك وعلى رزقك أفطرنا بأمرك فتقبله منا واغفر لنا إنك أنت الغفور الرحيم » غفر الله ما ادخل على صومه من النقصان بذنوبه.
thaqalaynSanad: And with the same chain of transmission, he (i.e., al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Faḍḍāl) has said that Imam al-Riḍā (as) has stated:
thaqalaynMatn: “Whoever recites the following supplication at the time he breaks his fast—O’ Allāh, for You we fasted through Your grant of success and upon Your sustenance we broke our fast upon Your command, so accept it from us and forgive us. Indeed, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful—Allāh will forgive him for what loss his fasting has incurred as a result of his sins.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: And with the same chain of transmission, he has reported that Imam al-Riḍā (as) said: “Good deeds in the month of Ramaḍān are accepted and misdeeds forgiven for he who reads a single verse of the Book of Allāh (azwj) during it, as though he had completed the entirety of the Qurʾān in any other month. Whoever causes his brother in belief to have laughter appear on his face will be let go on the Day of Judgement with laughter appearing on his own face, replete with glad tidings of Paradise. Whoever assists a fellow believer during this month, Allāh (taa) assists him by providing him with safe passage on the Bridge on the Day when other (people’s) feet will not find sure footing. Whoever restrains his own anger, Allāh will restrain His anger from him on the Day of Judgement, and whoever assists an oppressee during this month, Allāh will assist him against all of his enemies both in the worldly life and on the Day of Judgement, at the occasions of the Reckoning and the Scale. The month of Ramaḍān is one of blessings, mercy, forgiveness, repentance, and turning to Allāh. Whoever is not forgiven in the month of Ramaḍān, in which other month will he be forgiven? So ask Allāh to accept from you your fasts in this month, and that He not make it the last fulfilment of your covenant, and that He grant you the strength to obey Him and protect you from disobeying Him, for He is the worthiest One to be asked (for anything).”
arabicText: وبهذا الإسناد، قال الرضا (عليه السلام): الحسنات في شهر رمضان مقبولة والسيئات فيه مغفورة، من قرأ في شهر رمضان آية من كتاب الله عز وجل كان كمن ختم قرآن في غيره من الشهور، ومن ضحك فيه في وجه أخيه المؤمن لم يلقه يوم القيامة إلا ضحك في وجهه وبشره بالجنة ومن أعان فيه مؤمناً أعانه الله تعالى على الجواز على الصراط يوم تزل فيه الأقدام، ومن كف فيه غضبه كف الله عنه غضبه يوم القيامة، ومن نصر فيه مظلوماً نصره الله على كل من عاداه في الدنيا ونصره يوم القيامة عند الحساب والميزان. شهر رمضان شهر البركة وشهر الرحمة وشهر المغفرة وشهر التوبة والإنابة، من لم يغفر له في شهر رمضان ففي أي شهر يغفر له، فاسألوا الله أن يتقبل منكم فيه الصيام ولا يجعله آخر العهد منكم وأن يوفقكم فيه لطاعته ويعصمكم من معصيته إنه خير مسؤول.
thaqalaynSanad: And with the same chain of transmission, he has reported that Imam al-Riḍā (as) said:
thaqalaynMatn: “Good deeds in the month of Ramaḍān are accepted and misdeeds forgiven for he who reads a single verse of the Book of Allāh (azwj) during it, as though he had completed the entirety of the Qurʾān in any other month. Whoever causes his brother in belief to have laughter appear on his face will be let go on the Day of Judgement with laughter appearing on his own face, replete with glad tidings of Paradise. Whoever assists a fellow believer during this month, Allāh (taa) assists him by providing him with safe passage on the Bridge on the Day when other (people’s) feet will not find sure footing. Whoever restrains his own anger, Allāh will restrain His anger from him on the Day of Judgement, and whoever assists an oppressee during this month, Allāh will assist him against all of his enemies both in the worldly life and on the Day of Judgement, at the occasions of the Reckoning and the Scale. The month of Ramaḍān is one of blessings, mercy, forgiveness, repentance, and turning to Allāh. Whoever is not forgiven in the month of Ramaḍān, in which other month will he be forgiven? So ask Allāh to accept from you your fasts in this month, and that He not make it the last fulfilment of your covenant, and that He grant you the strength to obey Him and protect you from disobeying Him, for He is the worthiest One to be asked (for anything).”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan b. Aḥmad b. al-Walīd (ra) narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār narrated to him among others, from Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad b. Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād b. ʿUthmān, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh (as), who said: “Amīr al-Muʾminīn (as) has stated: “Fasting in the month of patience—i.e., Ramaḍān—and fasting three days in every month drives away the anxieties in the chest.” It has also been narrated from him that he said: “Fasting three days in every month counts as fasting for a whole year, and Allāh (azwj) has indeed said: ﴾Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof﴿ [6:160].”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد رضي الله عنه، قال: حدثنا محمد بن الحسن الصفّار، عن أحمد بن محمد بن عيسى، عن محمد بن أبي عمير، عن حماد بن عثمان، عن الحلبي، عن أبي عبد الله (عليه السلام)، قال: قال أمير المؤمنين (عليه السلام): صيام شهر الصبر وصيام ثلاثة أيام في كل شهر يذهب بلابل الصدور، وروي: صيام ثلاثة أيام في كل شهر صيام الدهر، إن الله عز وجل يقول: ﴿مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ عَشْرُ أَمْثَالِهَا﴾.
thaqalaynSanad: Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan b. Aḥmad b. al-Walīd (ra) narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār narrated to him among others, from Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad b. Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād b. ʿUthmān, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh (as), who said: “Amīr al-Muʾminīn (as) has stated:
thaqalaynMatn: “Fasting in the month of patience—i.e., Ramaḍān—and fasting three days in every month drives away the anxieties in the chest.” It has also been narrated from him that he said: “Fasting three days in every month counts as fasting for a whole year, and Allāh (azwj) has indeed said: ﴾Whoever comes with a good deed will have ten times the like thereof﴿ [6:160].”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm b. Isḥāq (ra) narrated to us, saying that Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Kūfī narrated to him among others, saying that al-Mundhir b. Muḥammad informed him among others, saying that al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī al-Khazzāz said: “I entered upon Abi’l-Ḥasan ʿAlī b. Mūsā al-Riḍā (as) on the last Friday of Shaʿbān, while a group of his companions were with him, among them ʿAbd al-Salām b. Ṣāliḥ, Ṣafwān b. Yaḥyā, Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Abī Naṣr, Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl b. Bazīʿ, Muḥammad b. Sinān, and his two housekeepers, Yāsir and Nādir, and others besides. He said: “O’ gathering of my Shīʿa, this is the last day of Shaʿbān. Whoever spends it in fasting, seeking the reward thereby, will earn himself forgiveness.” Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl asked him: “O’ son of the Messenger of Allāh, what do you make of that which has been narrated prohibiting fasting for a day or two before Ramaḍān?” So the Imam (as) replied: “O’ son of Ismāʿīl, indeed “Ramaḍān” is a name from among the names of Allāh (azwj), so do not say: “It came,” or “It passed,” or “It began,” while this month is the month of Allāh (azwj), and it is attributed to Him.” Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl responded: “So, is it permissible for anyone to say: “I began the month of Ramaḍān with a day or two of fasting”?” To which the Imam replied: “No, for “beginning” only applies to a thing that already exists and can be known. As for that which has not yet been created, how can it begin?” Muḥammad b. Ismāʿīl then asked: “O’ son of the Messenger of Allāh, although the month of Ramaḍān has not yet been created before its initiation, we are nevertheless certain that it will be.” The Imam replied: “O’ Muḥammad, you (say that you) are certain that it will be—and how are you certain that it will be?—what if the first night of the month of Ramaḍān extends until morning breaks and it is the Day of Judgement? So then there shall never be a month of Ramaḍān in the world, not ever, and people will wake up in the morning to find that they do not see a sun, or day, or any trace of the mosques of Allāh upon the face of the earth, and Allāh will raise the Kaaba and the Sacred Mosque (i.e. Masjid al-Ḥarām) to the sky. In such an age as that, the Qurʾān would be forgotten by people until you would not find a single adherent of the Qurʾān among them, or anything of those who remember and glorify Allāh. That is when Allāh will raise His decisive proof from the earth such that it collapses onto itself, its inhabitants in tow. The mountains shall tremble, the seas overflow, graves scattered, and the sun will curl up against the sky. The stars shall darken, and the planets disperse. On the day the Great Happening shall happen, and the sky split open, for on that day it will be flimsy.” He (as) continued: “O’ gathering of my Shīʿa! When the crescent of the month of Ramaḍān appears, do not point at it with your fingers, but rather orient yourselves towards the Qibla, raise your hands to the sky and address the crescent, saying—Our Lord and yours is Allāh, Lord of the worlds. O’ Allāh, make it for us a blessed crescent and grant us the ability to fast in the month of Ramaḍān. Keep us secure during it and accept it from us in ease and wellness. Allow us to take advantage of it to obey You, for indeed You are upon all things Omnipotent—there is no servant that does that except that Allāh (twt) will have written for him an inclusion among those liable for receiving Divine mercy and establish his name in the registry of those who will be forgiven. Fāṭima (as-f), the Mistress of the Women of the Worlds, would say as such every year when the crescent heralded the month of Ramaḍān, but her light would overpower that of the moon, until she went out of sight and so it would reappear.”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن إبراهيم بن إسحاق رضي الله عنه، قال: حدثنا أحمد بن محمد الكوفي، قال: أخبرنا المنذر بن محمد، قال: حدثنا الحسن بن علي الخزّاز، قال: دخلت على أبي الحسن علي بن موسى الرضا (عليه السلام) آخر جمعة من شعبان وعنده نفر من أصحابه منهم عبد السلام بن صالح وصفوان بن يحيى وأحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر ومحمد بن إسماعيل بن بزيع ومحمد بن سنان وخادماه ياسر ونادر وغيرهما، فقال: معاشر شيعتي هذا آخر يوم من شعبان من صامه احتساباً غفر له، فقال له محمد بن إسماعيل: يا ابن رسول الله فما تصنع بالخبر الذي روي في النهي عن استقبال رمضان بيوم أو يومين؟ فقال (عليه السلام): يا ابن إسماعيل إن رمضان اسم من أسماء الله عز وجل فلا يقال له: جاء وذهب واستقبل، والشهر شهر الله عز وجل وهو مضاف إليه فقال محمد بن إسماعيل: فهل يجوز لأحد أن يقول: استقبلت شهر رمضان بيوم أو يومين؟ قال: لا، لأن الاستقبال إنما يقع لشئ موجود يدرك فأما ما لم يخلق فكيف يستقبل؟ فقال يا ابن رسول الله شهر رمضان وإن لم يخلق قبل دخوله فقد وقع اليقين بأنه سيكون. فقال: يا محمد إن وقع لك اليقين أنه سيكون [فكيف وقع لك اليقين بأنه سيكون] وربما طالت ليلة أول يوم من شهر رمضان حتى يكون صبحها يوم القيامة فلا يكون شهر رمضان في الدنيا أبداً فيصبح الناس لا يرون شمساً ولا نهاراً ولا يرون من مساجد الله على وجه الأرض شيئاً ويرفع الله الكعبة والمسجد الحرام إلى السماء وأنسى في مثل ذلك الزمان القرآن حتى لا يوجد فيهم للقرآن حافظ ولشئ من تمجيد الله ذاكر فحينئذ يرفع الله عز وجل حجته من الأرض فتسيخ بأهلها وتسير جبالها وتسجر بحارها وتبعثر قبورها ويكور عن السماء شمسها وينكدر نجومها وينتثر كواكبها فيومئذ وقعت الواقعة وانشقت السماء فهي يومئذ واهية. ثم قال (عليه السلام): معاشر شيعتي إذا طلع هلال شهر رمضان فلا تشيروا إليه بالأصابع ولكن استقبلوا القبلة وارفعوا أيديكم إلى السماء وخاطبوا الهلال وقولوا: « ربنا وربك الله رب العالمين. اللهم اجعله علينا هلالاً مباركاً، ووفقنا لصيام شهر رمضان وسلمنا فيه وتسلمنا منه في يسر وعافية واستعملناه فيه بطاعتك إنك على كل شئ قدير »، فما من عبد فعل ذلك إلا كتبه الله تبارك وتعالى في جملة المرحومين وأثبته في ديوان المغفورين ولقد كانت فاطمة سيدة نساء العالمين (عليها السلام) تقول ذلك سنة فإذا طلع هلال شهر رمضان فكان نورها يغلب الهلال يخفى فإذا غابت عنه ظهر.

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. ʿAlī (b.) Mājīlawayh narrated to us, saying that his paternal uncle, Muḥammad b. Abī’l-Qāsim narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Qurashī narrated to him, saying that Abū’l-Rabīʿ narrated to him among others, thereby informing him of it, from Layth b. Abī Salīm, from Mujāhid, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās has said: “I heard the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) saying, and that was during the month of Ramaḍān: “Indeed, Allāh (jj) says, every night of this month: “By My Glory and Might, I have commanded My angels to open up the gates of the Celestial Realms for those among My male and female servants. So why do I see My servant being neglectful and absent-minded about Me? When has he asked Me, and I have not given him? When has he invoked Me, and I have not responded to him? When has he whispered to Me, and I have not drawn near to him? When has he sought Me, and I have disappointed him? When has he hoped in Me, and I have deprived him? When has he knocked upon My Door, and I have concealed Myself from him? When has he sought closeness to Me, and I have distanced Myself from him? When has he fled from Me, and I have not called upon him (to come back)? When has he returned to Me, and I have not accepted him back? When has he confessed his sins to Me, and I have not had mercy upon him? When has he sought My forgiveness, and I have not forgiven him his sin? When has he repented, and I have not accepted his repentance? Servant of Mine, how do you place your hopes with an earthly king who himself is a subject (of Mine), and yet you do not place your hopes with Me while I am the King of kings? How do you ask he who fears poverty, and yet you do not ask Me, while I am the Infinitely Wealthy Who does not fear to go poor? How do you serve a king who sleeps and will die, but you do not serve Me, while I am the Eternally Alive, Who will not ever die, Who will never fall prey to slumber nor fall asleep? Woe to those who disobey Me! How miserable are those who despair of My mercy! By My Might, I swear, that I will seize him with such a seizing as appropriate of the Almighty, the All-Powerful, Who lets known His wrath that unleashes itself upon Heaven and Earth! Where will you run to from Me, except to Me! For I am Allāh, the Almighty, the All-Wise.”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن علي ماجيلويه، قال: حدثنا عمي محمد بن أبي القاسم، قال: حدثني محمد بن علي القرشي، قال: حدثنا أبو الربيع أخبر به، عن ليث بن أبي سليم، عن مجاهد، قال: قال عبد الله بن عبّاس: سمعت رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله) يقول، وذلك في شهر رمضان: إن الله جل جلاله يقول كل ليلة من هذا الشهر: وعزتي وجلالي لقد أمرت ملائكتي بفتح أبواب سماوات للداعين من عبادي وإمائي فما لي أرى عبدي الغافل ساهياً عني متى سألني فلم أعطه ومتى ناداني فلم أجبه ومتى ناجاني فلم أقربه ومتى رجاني فخيبته ومتى أملني فحرمته ومتى قصد بابي فحجبته ومتى تقرب فباعدته ومتى هرب مني فلم أدعه ومتى رجع إلي فلم أقبله ومتى أقر بذنوبه فلم أرحمه ومتى استغفرني فلم اغفر له ذنبه ومتى تاب فلم أقبله توبته عبدي كيف تقصد برجائك ملكاً مملوكاً ولا تقصدني برجائك وأنا ملك الملوك أم كيف تسأل من يخاف الفقر ولا تسألني وأنا الغني الذي لا افتقر أم كيف تخدم ملكاً ينام ويموت ولا تخدمني وأنا الحي الذي لا يموت ولا يأخذني سنة ولا نوم يا سوئه لمن عصاني ويا بؤساً للقانطين من رحمتي بعزتي حلفت لآخذنه أخذ عزيز مقتدر يغضب لغضبه السماء والأرض فأين تفر مني إلا ألي وأنا الله العزيز الحكيم.

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. ʿAlī (b.) Mājīlawayh (ra) narrated to us, saying that his paternal uncle, Muḥammad b. Abī’l-Qāsim narrated to him, saying that Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Qurashī narrated to him, saying that Abū’l-Rabīʿ narrated to him among others, saying that Jarīr narrated to him among others, from Layth b. Abī Salīm, from Mujāhid, who said that ʿAbd Allāh b. ʿAbbās has stated: “I heard the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) saying: “The month of Ramaḍān is not like other months. Why should it not be as such when, during it, rewards are doubled, and it is the month of fasting, and of standing tall (for prayer), and of repentance and seeking forgiveness? And it is also the month to recite the Qurʾān, and the month in which the gates of the Paradisiacal realms are opened while the gates to the pits of Perdition are shut. It is the month in which the terms of life are recorded and sustenances distributed, and during it is the Night in which every matter of wisdom is differentiated, and the pilgrims to the sanctified House of Allāh are recorded. On this Night the angels descend, and the (Holy) Spirit—with the permission of their Lord—upon every fasting man and woman, to decide every matter of peace, until the breaking of dawn. Whoever is not forgiven in the month of Ramaḍān shall not be forgiven until the next. So hasten to the performance of righteous deeds now, while the door of repentance is open and supplications are due to receive answers, before you say to yourself: “Woe betide me for what I neglected in relation to Allāh, for I was among those who mocked.”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن علي ماجيلويه رضي الله عنه، قال: حدثني عمي محمد بن أبي القاسم، قال: حدثني محمد بن علي القرشي، قال: حدثنا أبو الربيع، قال: حدثنا جرير، عن ليث بن أبي سليم، عن مجاهد، قال: قال عبد الله بن عبّاس: سمعت رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله) يقول: شهر رمضان ليس كالشهور لما تضاعف فيه من الأجور هو شهر الصيام وشهر القيام وشهر التوبة والاستغفار وشهر تلاوة القرآن، هو شهر أبواب الجنان فيه مفتحة وأبواب النيران فيه مغلقة، هو شهر يكتب فيه الآجال ويبث فيه الأرزاق، وفيه ليلة فيها يفرق كل أمر حكيم ويكتب فيها وفد بيت الله الحرام تتنزل الملائكة والروح فيها عليه الصائمين والصائمات بإذن ربهم في كل أمر سلام هي حتى مطلع الفجر، من لم يغفر له في شهر رمضان لم يغفر إلى قابل فبادروا بالأعمال الصالحات الآن وباب التوبة مفتوح والدعاء مستجاب قبل أن تقول نفس: يا حسرتي على ما فرطت في جنب الله وإن كنت لمن الساخرين.

On this Night the angels descend, and the (Holy) Spirit—with the permission of their Lord—upon every fasting man and woman, to decide every matter of peace, until the breaking of dawn. Whoever is not forgiven in the month of Ramaḍān shall not be forgiven until the next. So hasten to the performance of righteous deeds now, while the door of repentance is open and supplications are due to receive answers, before you say to yourself: “Woe betide me for what I neglected in relation to Allāh, for I was among those who mocked.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: ʿAlī b. Aḥmad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Barqī narrated to us, saying that his father narrated to him among others, from his grandfather, Aḥmad b. Abī ʿAbd Allāh, who said that Abū’l-Ḥasan ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn al-Barqī narrated to him among others, saying that his father narrated to him among others, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Jabila, from Muʿāwiya b. ʿAmmār, from al-Ḥasan b. ʿAbd Allāh, from his forefathers, from his grandfather, al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib (as), who said: “A group of Jews came to the Messenger of Allāh (sawa), so the most knowledgeable among them asked him about certain matters. Among the things that this Jew asked him was: “For which reason did Allāh (azwj) mandate fasting upon your community, during the daylight hours, for thirty days, even though Allāh has mandated upon other communities more than that?” In response, the Holy Prophet (sawa) said: “Indeed, that which Ādam ate from the (Forbidden) Tree remained in his stomach for thirty days, so Allāh (azwj) mandated upon his offspring thirty days of hunger and thirst. Meanwhile, to eat during the night is a favour from Allāh (azwj) upon them. So, that which was mandated upon Ādam by Allāh has similarly been mandated upon my community.” Then, the Messenger of Allāh (sws) recited the following verse: ﴾O’ you who have believed, decreed upon you is fasting as it was decreed upon those before you that you may become righteous, for a limited number of days.﴿ [2:183-184]. The Jew said: “You have spoken truly, o’ Muḥammad! So, what is the recompense for he who fasts accordingly?” The Holy Prophet (sawa) replied: “There is not a believing person who fasts in the month of Ramaḍān, having accounted for its reward, except that Allāh (azwj) mandates upon him seven characteristics. Firstly, that which is prohibited (ḥarām) is flushed from his body. Secondly, he draws near to the mercy of Allāh (azwj). Thirdly, he is made to compensate for the misdemeanour of his forefather, Ādam. Fourthly, the throes of death are made easy for him. Fifthly, he is given security from hunger and thirst on the Day of Reckoning. Sixthly, Allāh grants him absolution from Perdition. Seventhly, Allāh (azwj) shall feed him from the good, natural things of Paradise.” The Jew spoke: “You have spoken truly, o’ Muḥammad!”
arabicText: حدثنا علي بن أحمد بن عبد الله بن أبي عبد الله البرقي، قال: حدثنا أبي، عن جده أحمد بن أبي عبد الله، قال: حدثنا أبو الحسن علي بن الحسين البرقي، قال: حدثنا أبي عن عبد الله بن جبلة، عن معاوية بن عمار، عن الحسن بن عبد الله، عن آبائه، عن جده الحسن بن علي بن أبي طالب (عليه السلام)، قال: جاء نفر من اليهود إلى رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله) فسأله أعلمهم عن مسائل فكان فيما سأله أن قال له: لأي شئ فرض الله عز وجل الصوم على أمتك بالنهار ثلاثين يوماً وفرض الله على الأمم أكثر من ذلك؟ فقال النبي (صلى الله عليه وآله): إن آدم لما أكل من الشجرة بقي في بطنه ثلاثين يوماً ففرض الله عز وجل على ذريته ثلاثين يوماً الجوع والعطش والذي يأكلونه بالليل تفضل من الله عز وجل عليهم وكذلك كان على آدم ففرض الله ذلك على أمتي. ثم تلا رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) هذه الآية: ﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلصِّيَامُ كَمَا كُتِبَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ ۝ أَيَّامًۭا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍۢ﴾ قال اليهودي: صدقت يا محمد فما جزاء من صامها؟ فقال النبي (صلى الله عليه وآله): ما من مؤمن يصوم شهر رمضان احتساباً الا أوجب الله عز وجل له سبع خصال: أولها—يذوب الحرام في جسده. والثانية—يقرب من رحمة الله عز وجل. والثالثة—يكون قد كفر خطيئة أبيه آدم. والرابعة—يهون عليه سكرات الموت. والخامسة—أمان من الجوع والعطش يوم القيامة. والسادسة—يعطيه الله براءة من النار. والسابعة—يطعمه الله عز وجل من طيبات الجنة، قال: صدقت يا محمد.

Abī ʿAbd Allāh, who said that Abū’l-Ḥasan ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn al-Barqī narrated to him among others, saying that his father narrated to him among others, from ʿAbd Allāh b. category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Aḥmad b. Ziyād b. Jaʿfar al-Hamadānī narrated to us, saying that ʿAlī b. Ibrāhīm b. Hāshim narrated to him among others, from his father, from Muḥammad b. Abī ʿUmayr, saying that Hishām b. al-Ḥakam narrated to him among others, who said: “I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh (as) about the reason for which fasting was ordained. He said: “The reason for fasting is to put the plutocrat and the pauper on equal grounds. That is because the plutocrat has not found himself touched by hunger, so he may have mercy upon the pauper, because the plutocrat can intend to do anything and he has the capability to do so. So, Allāh (azwj) intends to establish equality between the creatures, and that the plutocrat may get a taste of hunger and hardship in order to do good upon the weak ones, and feed the hungry.”
arabicText: حدثنا أحمد بن زياد بن جعفر الهمداني، قال: حدثنا علي بن إبراهيم بن هاشم، عن أبيه، عن محمد بن أبي عمير، قال: حدثنا هشام بن الحكم، قال: سألت أبا عبد الله (عليه السلام) عن علة الصيام، قال: العلة في الصيام ليستوي به الغني والفقير وذلك أن الغني لم يكن ليجد مس الجوع فيرحم الفقير لأن الغني كلما أراد شيئاً قدر عليه فأراد الله عز وجل أن يسوي بين خلقة وأن يذيق الغني مس الجوع والألم ليحسن على الضعيف ويطعم الجائع.
thaqalaynSanad: Aḥmad b. Ziyād b. Jaʿfar al-Hamadānī narrated to us, saying that ʿAlī b. Ibrāhīm b. Hāshim narrated to him among others, from his father, from Muḥammad b. Abī ʿUmayr, saying that Hishām b. al-Ḥakam narrated to him among others, who said:
thaqalaynMatn: “I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh (as) about the reason for which fasting was ordained. He said: “The reason for fasting is to put the plutocrat and the pauper on equal grounds. That is because the plutocrat has not found himself touched by hunger, so he may have mercy upon the pauper, because the plutocrat can intend to do anything and he has the capability to do so. So, Allāh (azwj) intends to establish equality between the creatures, and that the plutocrat may get a taste of hunger and hardship in order to do good upon the weak ones, and feed the hungry.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Muḥammad b. Mūsā b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us, saying that ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn al-Saʿdābādī narrated to him among others, from Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Khālid, from Saʿīd b. Muḥammad, from ʿAmrū b. ʿAṭiyya al-ʿAwfī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who has reported that the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) has said: “There is not a servant (of Allāh) upon whom the month of Ramaḍān comes—so he fasts during the day, refrains from evil, keeps his vision (from that which he is not allowed to look at), and avoids what Allāh has prohibited to him—except that Allāh mandates upon him Paradise.”
arabicText: حدثنا محمد بن موسى بن المتوكّل رحمه الله، قال: حدثنا علي بن الحسين السعدآبادي، عن أحمد بن محمد بن خالد، عن سعيد بن محمد، عن عمرو بن عطيّة العوفي، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، قال: قال رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله): ما من عبد دخل عليه شهر رمضان فصام نهاره وكف شره وغض بصره واجتنب ما حرم الله عليه إلا أوجب الله له الجنة.
thaqalaynSanad: Muḥammad b. Mūsā b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us, saying that ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn al-Saʿdābādī narrated to him among others, from Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Khālid, from Saʿīd b. Muḥammad, from ʿAmrū b. ʿAṭiyya al-ʿAwfī, from Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who has reported that the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) has said:
thaqalaynMatn: “There is not a servant (of Allāh) upon whom the month of Ramaḍān comes—so he fasts during the day, refrains from evil, keeps his vision (from that which he is not allowed to look at), and avoids what Allāh has prohibited to him—except that Allāh mandates upon him Paradise.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: My father (rh) narrated to us, saying that Aḥmad b. Idrīs narrated to him among others, from Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Jabbār, from Ṣafwān b. Yaḥyā, from Isḥāq b. ʿAmmār, from al-Masʿamī that he heard Abā ʿAbd Allāh (as) advising his children, saying thus: “When the month of Ramaḍān comes upon you, struggle with your own selves, for it is the month in which sustenances are distributed and terms (of life) are recorded, and those who visit Allāh have their visitation also recorded. And during this month is a Night wherein deeds done are fairer than those done in a thousand months.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبي رحمه الله، قال: حدثنا أحمد بن إدريس، عن محمد بن عبد الجبّار، عن صفوان بن يحيى، عن إسحاق بن عمار، عن المسمعي أنه سمع أبا عبد الله (عليه السلام) يوصي ولده ويقول: إذا دخل شهر رمضان فأجهدوا أنفسكم فإن فيه يقسم الأرزاق ويكتب الآجال وفيه يكتب وفد الله الذين يفدون وفيه ليلة العمل فيها خير من العمل في الف شهر.
thaqalaynSanad: My father (rh) narrated to us, saying that Aḥmad b. Idrīs narrated to him among others, from Muḥammad b. ʿAbd al-Jabbār, from Ṣafwān b. Yaḥyā, from Isḥāq b. ʿAmmār, from al-Masʿamī that he heard Abā ʿAbd Allāh (as) advising his children, saying thus:
thaqalaynMatn: “When the month of Ramaḍān comes upon you, struggle with your own selves, for it is the month in which sustenances are distributed and terms (of life) are recorded, and those who visit Allāh have their visitation also recorded. And during this month is a Night wherein deeds done are fairer than those done in a thousand months.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: ʿAlī b. Aḥmad b. Mūsā (ra) narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Kūfī narrated to him, saying that Abū’l-Khayr Ṣāliḥ b. Abī Ḥammād narrated to him among others, saying: “I wrote to Abī Muḥammad al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Muḥammad b. ʿAlī b. Mūsā b. Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad b. ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn b. ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib (as-p)—i.e., Imam al-ʿAskarī—asking him about the ritual bath in the nights of the month of Ramaḍān, so he (as) wrote back to me as thus: “If you can perform the ritual bath on the nights of the seventeenth, the nineteenth, the twenty-first, and the twenty-third, respectively, then do that, for in that is the establishment of hope for the Night of Power. If you cannot keep vigil during all of these nights, then do not let the opportunity to revive the twenty-third night escape you. Revive it by performing a hundred units of prayer, and recite in each unit (the chapter of) al-Ḥamd once and the chapter of ﴾Say: “He is Allāh, Who is One”﴿ ten times.”
arabicText: حدثنا علي بن أحمد بن موسى رضي الله عنه، قال: حدثني محمد بن أبي عبد الله الكوفي، قال: حدثنا أبو الخير صالح بن أبي حماد، قال: كتبت إلى أبي محمد الحسن بن علي بن محمد بن علي بن موسى بن جعفر بن محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن علي بن أبي طالب (عليهم السلام)، أسأله عن الغسل في ليالي شهر رمضان فكتب (عليه السلام): إن استطعت أن تغتسل ليلة سبعة عشرة وليلة تسعة عشرة وليلة إحدى وعشرين وليلة ثلاث وعشرين فافعل فإن فيها ترجى ليلة القدر فإن لم تقدر على إحيائها فلا يفوتنك إحياء ليلة ثلاث وعشرين تصلي فيها مائة ركعة تقرأ في كل ركعة الحمد مرة و﴿قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ﴾ عشر مرات.
thaqalaynSanad: ʿAlī b. Aḥmad b. Mūsā (ra) narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Kūfī narrated to him, saying that Abū’l-Khayr Ṣāliḥ b. Abī Ḥammād narrated to him among others, saying:
thaqalaynMatn: “I wrote to Abī Muḥammad al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī b. Muḥammad b. ʿAlī b. Mūsā b. Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad b. ʿAlī b. al-Ḥusayn b. ʿAlī b. Abī Ṭālib (as-p)—i.e., Imam al-ʿAskarī—asking him about the ritual bath in the nights of the month of Ramaḍān, so he (as) wrote back to me as thus: “If you can perform the ritual bath on the nights of the seventeenth, the nineteenth, the twenty-first, and the twenty-third, respectively, then do that, for in that is the establishment of hope for the Night of Power. If you cannot keep vigil during all of these nights, then do not let the opportunity to revive the twenty-third night escape you.
