category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū’l-Ḥasan Muḥammad b. ʿAmrū b. ʿAlī b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Baṣrī narrated to us, saying that Abū’l-Faḍl Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Ḥamdūn al-Nasāī narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Azdī narrated to him among others, in Baghdad—and he was trustworthy—saying that al-Ḥasan b. ʿAbd al-Wahhāb b. ʿAṭā narrated to him among others, saying that al-Haytham b. Abī’l-Ḥadārī narrated to him among others, from Zayd al-ʿAmī, from Abī Naḍra, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh, from the Holy Prophet (sawa), who said: “My community has been given five things in the month of Ramaḍān which no community of any prophet before me has been given. The first—on the first night of the month of Ramaḍān, Allāh looks at a person—and whoever Allāh looks at, He does not punish. The second—the odour that emanates from deep in their mouths when they sleep is naturally sweeter in the view of Allāh than the scent of musk. The third—the angels will seek forgiveness for them on their behalf during their nights and days. The fourth—Allāh (azwj) will command His Garden, saying: “Prepare and adorn yourself for My servants, for they will be relieved of the burdens and hardship of the world imminently, and enter My Garden and Honour.” The fifth—on the last night, He forgives them all.” A man asked: “Do you speak of the Night of Power, o’ Messenger of Allāh?,” so he replied: “Do you not see that when workers complete their tasks, they are given their dues?”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو الحسن محمد بن عمرو بن علي بن عبد الله البصري، قال: حدثنا أبو الفضل أحمد بن محمد بن حمدون النساي، قال: حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله الأزدي ببغداد وكان ثقة، قال: حدثنا الحسن بن عبد الوهاب بن عطا، قال: حدثنا الهيثم بن أبي الحداري، عن زيد العمي، عن أبي نضرة، عن جابر بن عبد الله، عن النبي (صلى الله عليه وآله)، قال: أعطيت أمتي في شهر رمضان خمساً لم يعطهن أمة نبي قبلي. أما واحدة—فإذا كان أول ليلة من شهر رمضان نظر الله إليه ومن نظر الله إليه لم يعذبه أبداً، وأما الثانية—فإن خلوف أفواههم حين يمسون أطيب عند الله من ريح المسك، وأما الثالثة—فإن الملائكة يستغفرون لهم في ليلهم ونهارهم، وأما الرابعة—فإن الله عز وجل يأمر جنته أن استعدي وتزيني لعبادي فيوشك أن يذهب عنهم نصب الدنيا وأذاها ويصيروا إلى جنتي وكرامتي، وأما الخامسة—فإذا كان آخر ليلة غفر لهم جميعاً. فقال رجل: ليلة القدر يا رسول الله؟ فقال: ألم تر إلى العمال إذا فرغوا من أعمالهم وفوا؟
thaqalaynSanad: Abū’l-Ḥasan Muḥammad b. ʿAmrū b. ʿAlī b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Baṣrī narrated to us, saying that Abū’l-Faḍl Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Ḥamdūn al-Nasāī narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Azdī narrated to him among others, in Baghdad—and he was trustworthy—saying that al-Ḥasan b. ʿAbd al-Wahhāb b. ʿAṭā narrated to him among others, saying that al-Haytham b. Abī’l-Ḥadārī narrated to him among others, from Zayd al-ʿAmī, from Abī Naḍra, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh, from the Holy Prophet (sawa), who said:
thaqalaynMatn: “My community has been given five things in the month of Ramaḍān which no community of any prophet before me has been given. The first—on the first night of the month of Ramaḍān, Allāh looks at a person—and whoever Allāh looks at, He does not punish. The second—the odour that emanates from deep in their mouths when they sleep is naturally sweeter in the view of Allāh than the scent of musk. The third—the angels will seek forgiveness for them on their behalf during their nights and days. The fourth—Allāh (azwj) will command His Garden, saying: “Prepare and adorn yourself for My servants, for they will be relieved of the burdens and hardship of the world imminently, and enter My Garden and Honour.” The fifth—on the last night, He forgives them all.” A man asked: “Do you speak of the Night of Power, o’ Messenger of Allāh?,” so he replied: “Do you not see that when workers complete their tasks, they are given their dues?”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us this narration, saying that Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad informed him, from al-Haytham b. al-Ḥarārī, from Zayd al-ʿAmī, from Abī Naḍra, saying: “I heard Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh saying: “The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) has said: “My community has been given five things in the month of Ramaḍān which no community of any prophet before me has been given,” and he mentioned the narration like it, in the same manner.”
arabicText: حدثنا بهذا الحديث أبو محمد عبد الله بن حامد، قال: أخبرني إبراهيم بن محمد، عن الهيثم بن الحراري، عن زيد العمي، عن أبي نضرة، قال: سمعت جابر بن عبد الله يقول: قال رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله) أعطيت أمتي في شهر رمضان خمساً لم يعطهن أمة نبي قبلي، وذكر الحديث مثله سواء.
thaqalaynSanad: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us this narration, saying that Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad informed him, from al-Haytham b. al-Ḥarārī, from Zayd al-ʿAmī, from Abī Naḍra, saying: “I heard Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh saying: “The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) has said:
thaqalaynMatn: “My community has been given five things in the month of Ramaḍān which no community of any prophet before me has been given,” and he mentioned the narration like it, in the same manner.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū’l-Ḥasan Muḥammad b. ʿAmrū b. ʿAlī b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Baṣrī narrated to us, saying that Abū ʿAmrū Muḥammad b. Khālid [or Jābir] al-Bukhārī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū Sahl Muḥammad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Sahl al-Muṭawʿī narrated to him among others, saying that Sufyān b. ʿAbd al-Ḥakīm narrated to him among others, saying that Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Salamī informed him, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Mubārak narrated to him among others, saying that Yaḥyā b. Ayyūb narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. Qurayṭ narrated to him among others, from ʿAṭā b. Yasār, from Abī Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who narrates: “I have heard the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) saying: “Whoever fasts in the month of Ramaḍān, having recognised its parameters—and maintains them as he should—then he has sufficiently expiated for whatever came before.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو الحسن محمد بن عمرو بن علي بن عبد الله البصري، قال: حدثنا أبو عمرو محمد بن خالد [جابر] البخاري، قال: حدثنا أبو سهل محمد بن عبد الله بن سهل المطوعي، قال: حدثنا سفيان بن عبد الحكيم، قال: أخبرني يحيى بن عبد الله السلمي، قال: حدثنا عبد الله بن المبارك، قال: حدثنا يحيى بن أيّوب، قال: حدثنا عبد الله بن قريط، عن عطا بن يسار، عن أبي سعيد الخدري، قال: سمعت رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله) يقول: من صام شهر رمضان يعرف حدوده ويتحفظ كما ينبغي له أن يتحفظ فقد كفر ما كان قبله.
thaqalaynSanad: Abū’l-Ḥasan Muḥammad b. ʿAmrū b. ʿAlī b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Baṣrī narrated to us, saying that Abū ʿAmrū Muḥammad b. Khālid [or Jābir] al-Bukhārī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū Sahl Muḥammad b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Sahl al-Muṭawʿī narrated to him among others, saying that Sufyān b. ʿAbd al-Ḥakīm narrated to him among others, saying that Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Salamī informed him, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Mubārak narrated to him among others, saying that Yaḥyā b. Ayyūb narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. Qurayṭ narrated to him among others, from ʿAṭā b. Yasār, from Abī Saʿīd al-Khudrī, who narrates: “I have heard the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) saying:
thaqalaynMatn: “Whoever fasts in the month of Ramaḍān, having recognised its parameters—and maintains them as he should—then he has sufficiently expiated for whatever came before.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū’l-Ḥasan Muḥammad b. ʿAmrū b. ʿAlī al-Baṣrī narrated to us, saying that Abū ʿAmrū Muḥammad b. Jābir al-Bukhārī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū Sahl al-Muṭawʿī narrated to him among others, saying that Sufyān b. ʿAbd al-Ḥakīm narrated to him, saying that Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Salamī narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Mubrad narrated to him among others, saying that Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar narrated to him among others, from Muḥammad b. ʿAmrū, from Abī Salama, from Abī Hurayra, who has said: “The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) would deliver sermons (in his time), and in one such sermon he said the following: “O’ people! Whoever fasts in the month of Ramaḍān in equity and tranquility, and restrains his hearing, his sight, and his tongue from lying, backbiting, bringing harm, or other prohibited matters will be made proximate—on the Day of Reckoning—until his knees touch those of Ibrāhīm (as), the confidante of the Most Merciful.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو الحسن محمد بن عمرو بن علي البصري، قال: حدثنا أبو عمرو محمد بن جابر البخاري، قال: حدثنا أبو سهل المطوعي، قال: حدثني سفيان بن عبد الحكيم، قال: حدثنا يحيى بن عبد الله السلمي، قال: حدثنا عبد الله بن المبرد، قال: حدثنا إسماعيل بن جعفر، عن محمد بن عمرو، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي هريرة، قال: كان رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله) يخطب، فقال في خطبته: أيها الناس من صام شهر رمضان في إنصاف وسكون وكف سمعه وبصره ولسانه من الكذب والحرام والغيبة والأذى قرب يوم القيامة حتى تمس ركبتيه ركبة إبراهيم خليل الرحمن (عليه السلام).
thaqalaynSanad: Abū’l-Ḥasan Muḥammad b. ʿAmrū b. ʿAlī al-Baṣrī narrated to us, saying that Abū ʿAmrū Muḥammad b. Jābir al-Bukhārī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū Sahl al-Muṭawʿī narrated to him among others, saying that Sufyān b. ʿAbd al-Ḥakīm narrated to him, saying that Yaḥyā b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Salamī narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. al-Mubrad narrated to him among others, saying that Ismāʿīl b. Jaʿfar narrated to him among others, from Muḥammad b. ʿAmrū, from Abī Salama, from Abī Hurayra, who has said:
thaqalaynMatn: “The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) would deliver sermons (in his time), and in one such sermon he said the following: “O’ people! Whoever fasts in the month of Ramaḍān in equity and tranquility, and restrains his hearing, his sight, and his tongue from lying, backbiting, bringing harm, or other prohibited matters will be made proximate—on the Day of Reckoning—until his knees touch those of Ibrāhīm (as), the confidante of the Most Merciful.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū’l-Ḥasan Muḥammad b. ʿAmrū b. ʿAlī al-Baṣrī narrated to us, saying that Abū ʿAmrū Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Bastarī narrated to him among others in Bastar, [1] saying that Abū Jaʿfar Aḥmad b. Yaḥyā b. Zuhayr al-ʿUsrī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū’l-Khaṭṭāb Ziyād b. Yaḥyā al-Ḥasanī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū Ghiyāth narrated to him among others, saying that Jarīr b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to him among others, from Abī Isḥāq, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾisha, who reported: “I heard the Messenger of Allāh (sws) saying: “There is not a servant who wakes up to fast except that the gates of the sky are opened up to him until he disappears behind the veil. Were he to perform a unit or two of voluntary prayers, the heavens would be brightly illuminated with a light from his wives from among the celestial maidens, who will say—O’ Allāh, bring him to us, for we long to see him!—and verily, every pronouncement of tahlīl (“There is no other god besides Allāh”) or tasbīḥ (“Glory be to Allāh”) is met with seventy thousand angels recording (the rewards thereof) until he disappears behind the veil.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو الحسن محمد بن عمرو بن علي البصري، قال: حدثنا أبو عمرو أحمد بن محمد البستري ببستر، قال: حدثنا أبو جعفر أحمد بن يحيى بن زهير العسري، قال: حدثنا أبو الخطّاب زياد بن يحيى الحساني، قال: حدثنا أبو غياث، قال: حدثنا جرير بن عبد الرحمن، عن أبي إسحاق، عن مسروق، عن عائشة أنها قالت: سمعت رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) يقول: ما من عبد أصبح صائماً إلا فتحت له أبواب السماء إلى أن توارى بالحجاب فإن صلى ركعة أو ركعتين تطوعاً أضائت له السماوات نوراً من أزواجه الحور العين، وقلن اللهم اقبضه إلينا فقد اشتقنا إلى رؤيته، وإن هلل أو سبح تلقاه سبعون الف ملك يكتبون إلى أن توارى بالحجاب.
thaqalaynSanad: Abū’l-Ḥasan Muḥammad b. ʿAmrū b. ʿAlī al-Baṣrī narrated to us, saying that Abū ʿAmrū Aḥmad b. Muḥammad al-Bastarī narrated to him among others in Bastar, [1] saying that Abū Jaʿfar Aḥmad b. Yaḥyā b. Zuhayr al-ʿUsrī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū’l-Khaṭṭāb Ziyād b. Yaḥyā al-Ḥasanī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū Ghiyāth narrated to him among others, saying that Jarīr b. ʿAbd al-Raḥmān narrated to him among others, from Abī Isḥāq, from Masrūq, from ʿĀʾisha, who reported: “I heard the Messenger of Allāh (sws) saying:
thaqalaynMatn: “There is not a servant who wakes up to fast except that the gates of the sky are opened up to him until he disappears behind the veil. Were he to perform a unit or two of voluntary prayers, the heavens would be brightly illuminated with a light from his wives from among the celestial maidens, who will say—O’ Allāh, bring him to us, for we long to see him!—and verily, every pronouncement of tahlīl (“There is no other god besides Allāh”) or tasbīḥ (“Glory be to Allāh”) is met with seventy thousand angels recording (the rewards thereof) until he disappears behind the veil.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū’l-Ḥasan Muḥammad b. ʿAlī b. al-Shāh informed us in Merv-on-the-River, [1] saying that Abū Bakr Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Yaʿqūb al-Anṭākī narrated to him among others in Antioch, saying that Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abī Jaʿfar al-Ḥalabī narrated to him among others in al-Ṣīṣiya, saying that al-Ṣīʿiyya al-Kabīr b. al-Maʿānī narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Marwān narrated to him among others, saying that Dāwūd b. Abī Hind [or ʿInd], from Abī Naḍra, from ʿAṭā b. Abī Riyāḥ, from Abī Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Messenger of Allāh (sws) said on a given day: “Verily, the gates of the sky are opened on the first night of the month of Ramaḍān and then are not shut until its last night. There is not a servant who performs prayer on a night of this month but that Allāh has 1,500 good deeds recorded for every prostration he performs, and constructed for him a dwelling—made of red rubies—in Heaven, with seventy thousand doors. Within this house is a palace made of gold, decorated with a single red ruby, and this palace also has seventy thousand doors. So, whoever fasts a day in the month of Ramaḍān, forgiven are all the sins that preceded him unto that day of the month of Ramaḍān, and likewise an expiation for all those sins that will come after. For every day that he fasts in the month of Ramaḍān is a palace (in Paradise) with a thousand doors of solid gold, and seventy thousand angels seeking forgiveness for him on his behalf, calling to him until he disappears behind the veil. Also, for every prostration he performs in day or in night is a tree under whose branches a rider could travel for a thousand years.”
arabicText: أخبرنا أبو الحسن محمد بن علي بن الشاه بمرو الرود، قال: حدثنا أبو بكر محمد بن إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن يعقوب الأنطاكي بأنطاكية، قال: حدثنا محمد بن أحمد بن أبي جعفر الحلبي بالصيصية، قال: حدثنا الصيعيّة الكبير بن المعاني، قال: حدثنا محمد بن مروان، قال: حدثنا داود بن أبي هند [عند]، عن أبي نضرة، عن عطا بن أبي رياح، عن أبي سعيد الخدري إن رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) قال ذات يوم: إن أبواب السماء لتفتح في أول ليلة من شهر رمضان ثم لا تغلق إلى آخر ليلة منه وليس من عبد يصلي في ليلة منها إلا كتب الله له بكل سجدة ألفا وخمسمائة حسنة وبنى له بيت في الجنة من ياقوتة حمراء لها سبعون الف باب منها قصر من ذهب موشحاً بياقوتة حمراء لها سبعون الف باب فإذا صام يوماً من شهر رمضان غفر له كل ذنب تقدم إلى ذلك اليوم من شهر رمضان وكان كفارة إلى مثلها من الحول وكان له بكل يوم يصومه من شهر رمضان قصر له الف باب من ذهب واستغفر له سبعون الف ملك يدعونه إلى أن توارى بالحجاب، وكان له بكل سجدة يسجدها من ليل أو نهار شجرة يسير فيها الراكب الف عام.
thaqalaynSanad: Abū’l-Ḥasan Muḥammad b. ʿAlī b. al-Shāh informed us in Merv-on-the-River, [1] saying that Abū Bakr Muḥammad b. Ibrāhīm b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Yaʿqūb al-Anṭākī narrated to him among others in Antioch, saying that Muḥammad b. Aḥmad b. Abī Jaʿfar al-Ḥalabī narrated to him among others in al-Ṣīṣiya, saying that al-Ṣīʿiyya al-Kabīr b. al-Maʿānī narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Marwān narrated to him among others, saying that Dāwūd b. Abī Hind [or ʿInd], from Abī Naḍra, from ʿAṭā b. Abī Riyāḥ, from Abī Saʿīd al-Khudrī, that the Messenger of Allāh (sws) said on a given day:
thaqalaynMatn: “Verily, the gates of the sky are opened on the first night of the month of Ramaḍān and then are not shut until its last night. There is not a servant who performs prayer on a night of this month but that Allāh has 1,500 good deeds recorded for every prostration he performs, and constructed for him a dwelling—made of red rubies—in Heaven, with seventy thousand doors. Within this house is a palace made of gold, decorated with a single red ruby, and this palace also has seventy thousand doors. So, whoever fasts a day in the month of Ramaḍān, forgiven are all the sins that preceded him unto that day of the month of Ramaḍān, and likewise an expiation for all those sins that will come after. For every day that he fasts in the month of Ramaḍān is a palace (in Paradise) with a thousand doors of solid gold, and seventy thousand angels seeking forgiveness for him on his behalf, calling to him until he disappears behind the veil. Also, for every prostration he performs in day or in night is a tree under whose branches a rider could travel for a thousand years.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbdūs b. ʿAlī b. al-ʿAbbās al-Jurjānī narrated to us, saying that Abū’l-Qāsim ʿUbayd Allāh b. Yaʿqūb b. Yūsuf al-Rāzī narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Yūnus al-Karīmī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū ʿĀmir narrated to him among others, saying that Zamʿa narrated to him among others, from Salama, from ʿIkrima, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who reports: “I heard the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) saying: “Allāh (azwj) has said: “Other than fasting, which is for Me—and I shall reward him thus—every action of a son of Ādam is his, and fasting is the shield of the believing servant from the Fire, on the Day of Judgement, just as one of you protects himself with his weapon in the worldly life. For the odour that emanates from the mouth of the fasting person is more naturally good, in the sight of Allāh (azwj), than the scent of musk! And verily, for the fasting person, are two joys—one for when he breaks his fast, feeding himself and drinking, and the other for when he meets Me, and I admit him into Heaven.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو محمد عبدوس بن علي بن العبّاس الجرجاني، قال: حدثنا أبو القاسم عبيد الله بن يعقوب بن يوسف الرازي، قال: حدثنا محمد بن يونس الكريمي، قال: حدثنا أبو عامر، قال: حدثنا زمعة، عن سلمة، عن عكرمة، عن ابن عبّاس، قال: سمعت رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله) يقول: قال الله عز وجل: كل عمل ابن آدم هو له غير الصيام هو لي وأنا أجزي به والصيام جنة العبد المؤمن من النار يوم القيامة كما يقي أحدكم سلاحه في الدنيا ولخلوف فم الصائم أطيب عند الله عز وجل من ريح المسك وإن للصائم فرحتين حين يفطر فيطعم ويشرب وحين يلقاني فأدخله الجنة.
thaqalaynSanad: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbdūs b. ʿAlī b. al-ʿAbbās al-Jurjānī narrated to us, saying that Abū’l-Qāsim ʿUbayd Allāh b. Yaʿqūb b. Yūsuf al-Rāzī narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Yūnus al-Karīmī narrated to him among others, saying that Abū ʿĀmir narrated to him among others, saying that Zamʿa narrated to him among others, from Salama, from ʿIkrima, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who reports: “I heard the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) saying:
thaqalaynMatn: “Allāh (azwj) has said: “Other than fasting, which is for Me—and I shall reward him thus—every action of a son of Ādam is his, and fasting is the shield of the believing servant from the Fire, on the Day of Judgement, just as one of you protects himself with his weapon in the worldly life. For the odour that emanates from the mouth of the fasting person is more naturally good, in the sight of Allāh (azwj), than the scent of musk! And verily, for the fasting person, are two joys—one for when he breaks his fast, feeding himself and drinking, and the other for when he meets Me, and I admit him into Heaven.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: The Report about Prayers to be Performed on the Last Night of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbdūs b. ʿAlī b. al-ʿAbbās al-Jurjānī narrated to us, saying that Abū ʿImrān Mūsā b. al-Ḥusayn al-Bāghishī al-Muʾaddib narrated to him among others, saying that Abū ʿAbd Allāh Muḥammad b. Aḥmad al-Qurashī [or al-Quramī] narrated to him among others, saying that al-Ḥusayn b. ʿAlī b. Khālid informed him among others, saying that Maʿrūf b. al-Walīd narrated to him among others, saying that Saʿd b. ʿAbd Allāh narrated to him among others, saying that Abū Ṭayba narrated to him among others, from Kurdīn and Barad al-Ḥādī [or al-Ḥādawī], from al-Rabīʿ b. Khaytham, from ʿAbd Allāh b. Masʿūd, from the Holy Prophet (sawa), who said: “By He Who sent me forth with the Truth! Verily, Jibraʿīl has informed me, from Isrāfīl, from his Lord (twt), Who has said: “Whoever performs—in the last night of the month of Ramaḍān—a prayer consisting of ten units, of which each unit includes the recitation of the Opener of the Book (i.e., Sūrat al-Fātiḥa) once and the chapter of ﴾Say: “He is Allāh, Who is One”﴿ (i.e., Sūrat al-Tawḥīd) ten times, while in bowing and prostration the utterance of “Glory be to Allāh, and praise be to Allāh, there is no god but Allāh, and Allāh is ineffable” must be made ten times, and then the ritual testimony at the end of every two units. Then, after performing the invocation of peace and completing all ten units, the person should say in another invocation of peace: “I seek forgiveness from Allāh” a thousand times. After completing this invocation of forgiveness, he should return to prostration and say therein: O’ Ever-Living, o’ Sustainer of all existences, o’ Possessor of Splendour and Honour, o’ Entirely Merciful in the life of this world and the Hereafter, o’ Innately Merciful over both, o’ Most Merciful of all those who show mercy, o’ Deity of the first generations and the last! Forgive us our sins, and accept from us our prayers, fasting, and standing in worship.” The Holy Prophet (sawa) commented: “By He Who sent me forth with the Truth! Does Allāh accept his (good works in) Ramaḍān specifically, as well as those of the people of his land, generally?” Jibraʿīl responded: “Yes! By He Who sent you forth, it is due to his honour and the grandeur of his station with his Lord that Allāh will accept from him and from them their prayers, fasting, and standing for worship—He will forgive them their sins and answer his supplications.” The Holy Prophet continued: “By He Who sent me forth with the Truth! Verily, when a person performs this prayer and seeks forgiveness with this invocation of forgiveness, Allāh will accept from him his prayers, fasting, and standing in worship, forgive his sins, and answer his supplications, for Allāh (jj) says in His Book: ﴾Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, for He is truly Most Forgiving﴿ [71:10], and He says: ﴾So seek your Lord’s forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance﴿ [11:90]. And He has said: ﴾They are those who, upon committing an evil deed or wronging themselves, remember Allāh and seek forgiveness for their sins—and who forgives sins except Allāh?﴿ [3:135]. And He (azwj) has also said: ﴾And seek your Lord’s forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance. He will grant you a good provision for an appointed term and graciously reward the doers of good﴿ [11:3]. And He (azwj) has said: ﴾Seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance﴿ [110:3].” The Holy Prophet (sws) concluded: “This is a gift for me, specifically, and for my community—both its men and its women—such that Allāh (azwj) has not given this to anyone before me, whether from among the Prophets or anyone else.”

خالد، قال: حدثنا معروف بن الوليد، قال: حدثنا سعد بن عبد الله، قال: حدثنا أبو طيبة، عن كردين وبرد الحادي [الحادوي]، عن الربيع بن خيثم، عن عبد الله بن مسعود، عن النبي (صلى الله عليه وآله)، قال: والذي بعثني بالحق أن جبرئيل أخبرني عن إسرافيل عن ربه تبارك وتعالى أنه قال: من صلى في آخر ليلة من شهر رمضان عشر ركعات يقرأ في كل ركعة فاتحة الكتاب مرة و﴿قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ﴾، عشر مرات ويقول في ركوعه وسجوده عشر مرات: سبحان الله والحمد لله ولا إله إلا الله والله أكبر ويتشهد في كل ركعتين ثم يسلم فإذا فرغ من آخر عشر ركعات قال بعد فراغه من التسليم: استغفر الله، الف مرة، فإذا فرغ من الإستغفار سجد ويقول في سجوده: « يا حي يا قيوم يا ذا الجلال والإكرام يا رحمن الدنيا والآخرة ورحيمهما يا أرحم الراحمين يا إله الأولين والآخرين اغفرلنا ذنوبنا وتقبل منا صلاتنا وصيامنا وقيامنا ». قال النبي (صلى الله عليه وآله): والذي بعثني بالحق أنه لا يرفع رأسه من السجود حتى يغفر الله له ويتقبل منه شهر رمضان ويتجاوز عن ذنوبه وإن كان قد أذنب سبعين ذنباً كل ذنب أعظم من ذنوب العباد ويتقبل من جميع أهل الكورة التي هو فيها، وقال النبي (صلى الله عليه وآله) لجبرئيل (عليه السلام): يا جبرئيل يتقبل الله منه خاصة شهر رمضان ومن جميع أهل بلاده عامة، قال: نعم، والذي بعثك أنه من كرامته عليه وعظم منزلته لربه يتقبل الله منه جل جلاله يقول في كتابه: ﴿ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا﴾، ويقول: ﴿وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ﴾، وقال: ﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا۟ فَـٰحِشَةً أَوْ مَّتَـٰعًا حَسَنًا إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى وَيُؤْتِ كُلَّ ذِى فَضْلٍۢ فَضْلَهُۥ﴾، وقال عز وجل: ﴿وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا﴾، وقال النبي (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم): هذه هدية لي خاصة ولأمتي من الرجال والنساء لم يعطها الله عز وجل أحداً ممن كان قبلي من الأنبياء وغيرهم.

englishText: Abu Aḥmad Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar al-Bandār al-Shāfiʿī narrated to us in Farghāna, saying that the judge, Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan—Abū ʿAlī al-Tammār—narrated to him among others, saying that the judge, Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad al-Mustafāḍ al-Faryānī, narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd al-Aʿlā b. Ḥammād al-Barṣī narrated to him among others, saying that Sufyān b. ʿUyayna narrated to him among others, from al-Zuhrī, from Abī Salama, from Abī Hurayra, who reports: “The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) has said: “Whoever stands for worship on the Night of Power, having faith in and having accounted for its reward, will be forgiven for whatever preceded him of his sins.” The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) would revive this custom (yearly) and not end it.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو أحمد محمد بن جعفر البندار الشافعي بفرغانه، قال: حدثنا محمد بن الحسن القاضي أبو علي التمّار، قال: حدثنا جعفر بن محمد المستفاض الفرياني القاضي، قال: حدثنا عبد الأعلى بن حماد البرسي، قال: حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة، عن الزهري، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي هريرة، قال: قال رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله): من قام ليلة القدر إيماناً وإحتساباً غفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه، وكان رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله) يحييه ولا يختمه.

Jaʿfar al-Bandār al-Shāfiʿī narrated to us in Farghāna, saying that the judge, Muḥammad b. al-Ḥasan—Abū ʿAlī al-Tammār—narrated to him among others, saying that the judge, Jaʿfar b. category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: The Report about Prayers to be Performed on the Last Night of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū Aḥmad Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar al-Bandār narrated to us, saying that Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad b. Nūḥ narrated to him among others, saying that Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Aḥmad b. Ḥammād narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd al-Raḥīm b. Zayd narrated to him among others, from his father, from Saʿīd b. Jubayr, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who reports that the Messenger of Allāh (sws) has said: “Whoever experiences the month of Ramaḍān in Mecca, fasting and standing for worship therein as much as he is at ease to, will have his effort counted for as much as a hundred thousand months (spent doing the same) in any other land. For each day and each night, he gets the reward of equipping two horses in the way of Allāh. For each night, he gets the reward of freeing a slave. For each day and night, he gets the reward of giving charity, and for each day and night, he gets the reward of intercession. And for each day, he is elevated in rank by a degree.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو أحمد محمد بن جعفر البندار، قال: حدثنا جعفر بن محمد بن نوح، قال: حدثنا أبو محمد عبد الله بن أحمد بن حماد، قال: حدثنا عبد الرحيم بن زيد، عن أبيه، عن سعيد بن جبير، عن ابن عبّاس، قال: قال رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم): من أدرك شهر رمضان بمكّة فصامه وقامه بما تيسر له عدل مائة الف شهر فيما سواه من البلد وكان له بكل يوم حملان فرس في سبيل الله وكل ليلة حملان فرس في سبيل الله في كل ليلة عتق رقبة وكل يوم صدقة وكل ليلة صدقة وكل يوم شفاعة وكل ليلة شفاعة وكل يوم درجة.
thaqalaynSanad: Abū Aḥmad Muḥammad b. Jaʿfar al-Bandār narrated to us, saying that Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad b. Nūḥ narrated to him among others, saying that Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Aḥmad b. Ḥammād narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd al-Raḥīm b. Zayd narrated to him among others, from his father, from Saʿīd b. englishText: Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār narrated to us, saying that his father narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Abī’l-Ṣihbān narrated to him among others, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, who reports that Mūsā b. Jaʿfar (as) has said: “Absolved of his sins is he who performs the ritual bath for the Night of Power and then revives it—spending the whole night in worship—until the break of dawn.”
arabicText: حدثنا أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطّار، قال: حدثنا أبي، قال: حدثنا محمد بن أبي الصهبان، عن ابن أبي عمير، قال: قال موسى بن جعفر (عليه السلام): من اغتسل ليلة القدر وأحياها إلى طلوع الفجر خرج من ذنوبه.

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Aḥmad b. al-Ḥasan al-Qaṭṭān narrated to us, saying that Aḥmad b. Yaḥyā b. Zakariyyā al-Qaṭṭān narrated to him among others, saying that Bakr b. ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥabīb narrated to him among others, saying that Tamīm b. Bahlūl narrated to him among others, saying that Abū Muʿāwiya al-Ḍarīr narrated to him among others, from Ismāʿīl b. Mihrān, who narrates: “I heard Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad (as) say: “Whoever performs the ritual bath on its nights—in the month of Ramaḍān—will be absolved of his sins as like the newborn on the day his mother gave birth to him.” I said to him: “O’ son of the Messenger of Allāh (sws)! What are the nights of ritual bathing?” So he replied: “The seventeenth, nineteenth, twenty-first, and twenty-third nights of the month of Ramaḍān.” Ibn Mihrān continued his narration: “I said: “Is there a prayer to be performed in these nights different from those performed in the other nights of this month?,’ so he replied: “No, except for on the twenty-first and twenty-third nights—[because] hope is placed in these nights, that either of them is the true Night of Power, and it is recommended in each of the two nights to perform a hundred (units) of prayer—verily, whoever does that, Allāh will grant him absolution from Perdition and mandate upon him admission into Paradise, and he is allowed to intercede for (as many people as) the likes of (the tribes of) Rabīʿa and Muḍar (combined).”
arabicText: حدثنا أحمد بن الحسن القطّان، قال: حدثنا أحمد بن يحيى بن زكريّا القطّان، قال: حدثنا بكر بن عبد الله بن حبيب، قال: حدثنا تميم بن بهلول، قال: حدثنا أبو معاوية الضرير، عن إسماعيل بن مهران، قال: سمعت جعفر بن محمد (عليه السلام) يقول: من اغتسل ليالي الغسل من شهر رمضان خرج من ذنوبه كهيئة يوم ولدته أمه، فقلت: يا ابن رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) ما ليالي الغسل؟ قال: ليلة سبع عشرة وليلة تسع عشرة وليلة إحدى وعشرين وليلة ثلاث وعشرين من شهر رمضان، قال: فقلت: هل فيها صلاة غير ما في سائر ليالي الشهر؟ قال: لا، إلا في ليلة إحدى وعشرين وثلاث وعشرين [لأن] فإن فيها يرجو ليلة القدر ويستحب أن يصلي في كل ليلة منها مائة، فإن فعل ذلك أعتقه الله من النار وأوجب له الجنة وشفعه في مثل ربيعة ومضر.

chapter: The Report about Prayers to be Performed on the Last Night of the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Aḥmad b. al-Ḥasan al-Qaṭṭān narrated to us, saying that al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī al-Sukarī narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Zakariyyā al-Jawharī narrated to him among others, saying that Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmmāra narrated to him among others, from his father, from Jābir b. Yazīd al-Ju‘fī, from Abī Jaʿfar, Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Bāqir (as-d), who has said: “Whoever revives the twenty-third night of the month of Ramaḍān—by performing a hundred units of prayer—Allāh will broaden his means of living, suffice him in the matter of his enemies, spare him from drowning, destruction, and theft—from among the evils of the world—and relieve him of the terror of Munkar and Nakīr, and bring him out of his grave while his light fills up the people of the throng (on the Day of Judgement), and give him his record of deeds in his right hand, and record for him exoneration from Perdition, safe passage over the Bridge, and security from punishment, and admit him into Paradise—without any accountability—and make him one of the friends of the Prophets, the truth-speakers, the martyrs, and the righteous, and how great are they as friends!”
arabicText: حدثنا أحمد بن الحسن القطّان، قال: حدثنا الحسن بن علي السكري، قال: حدثنا محمد بن زكريّا الجوهري، قال: حدثنا جعفر بن محمد بن عمارة، عن أبيه، عن جابر بن يزيد الجعفي، عن أبي جعفر محمد بن علي الباقر (عليهما السلام)، قال: من أحيى ليلة ثلاث وعشرين من شهر رمضان وصلى فيها مائة ركعة وسع الله عليه معيشته، وكفاه أمر من يعاديه، وأعاذه من الغرق والهدم والسرق من شر الدنيا، ورفع عنه هول منكر ونكير، وخرج من قبره ونوره يتلألأ لأهل الجمع، ويعطى كتابه بيمينه، ويكتب له براءة من النار وجواز على الصراط وأمان من العذاب، ويدخل الجنة بغير حساب، ويجعل فيه رفقاء النبيين والصديقين والشهداء والصالحين، وحسن أولئك رفيقاً.
thaqalaynSanad: Aḥmad b. al-Ḥasan al-Qaṭṭān narrated to us, saying that al-Ḥasan b. ʿAlī al-Sukarī narrated to him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Zakariyyā al-Jawharī narrated to him among others, saying that Jaʿfar b. Muḥammad b. ʿAmmāra narrated to him among others, from his father, from Jābir b. Yazīd al-Ju‘fī, from Abī Jaʿfar, Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Bāqir (as-d), who has said:
thaqalaynMatn: “Whoever revives the twenty-third night of the month of Ramaḍān—by performing a hundred units of prayer—Allāh will broaden his means of living, suffice him in the matter of his enemies, spare him from drowning, destruction, and theft—from among the evils of the world—and relieve him of the terror of Munkar and Nakīr, and bring him out of his grave while his light fills up the people of the throng (on the Day of Judgement), and give him his record of deeds in his right hand, and record for him exoneration from Perdition, safe passage over the Bridge, and security from punishment, and admit him into Paradise—without any accountability—and make him one of the friends of the Prophets, the truth-speakers, the martyrs, and the righteous, and how great are they as friends!”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: The Report about Farewelling the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Aḥmad b. al-Ḥasan al-Qaṭṭān narrated to us, saying that Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. al-Saʿīd al-Hamadānī—the client of Banī Hāshim—narrated to him among others, from Jābir b. Yazīd, from Abī’l-Zubayr al-Makkī, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī, who narrates: “I entered upon the Messenger of Allāh (sws) on the last Friday of the month of Ramaḍān. When he noticed me, he said to me: “O’ Jābir! This is the last Friday of the month of Ramaḍān. Farewell it by saying thus—O’ Allāh, do not let this alone be the last fulfillment of our covenant with You, for if You make it so, then make me liable for mercy and not deprived of it—for whoever says that, then he has triumphed through one of two great ways—either he makes it to the next month of Ramaḍān, or he attains the supreme forgiveness of Allāh and His mercy.” Then he (as) said: “Verily, Allāh (twt) has not made fasting in the month of Ramaḍān a duty on any past peoples except for the Prophets—to the exclusion of their respective communities—and what was made a duty upon the Prophets and Messengers before me has only been made a duty upon you people as an act of honor and esteem. By He Who sent me forth with the Truth, Allāh did not grant anyone of the Prophets a virtue but that He granted it to me, too, while I have been given that which has not been given to them. And I have been favored over them sufficiently, and I am their master, the fairest among them, and their most virtuous one—and I do not say that with (unjustified) pride.”
arabicText: حدثنا أحمد بن الحسن القطّان، قال: حدثنا أحمد بن محمد بن السعيد الهمداني مولى بني هاشم، عن جابر بن يزيد، عن أبي الزبير المكّي، عن جابر بن عبد الله الأنصاري، قال: دخلت على رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) في آخر جمعة من شهر رمضان، فلما بصر بي قال لي: يا جابر هذا آخر جمعة من شهر رمضان فودعه وقل: « اللهم لا تجعله آخر العهد من صيامنا إياه فإن جعلته فاجعلني مرحوماً ولا تجعلني محروماً » فإنه من قال ذلك ظفر بإحدى الحسنيين، إما ببلوغ شهر رمضان وإما بغفران الله ورحمته. ثم قال (عليه السلام): إن الله تبارك وتعالى لن يفرض من صيام شهر رمضان فيما مضى إلا على الأنبياء دون أممهم، وإنما فرض عليكم ما فرض على أنبيائه ورسله قبلي إكراماً وتفضيلاً، والذي بعثني بالحق ما أعطى الله نبياً من أنبيائه فضيلة إلا أعطانيها، ولقد أعطاني ما لم يعطهم وفضلني على كافتهم، وأنا سيدهم وخيرهم وأفضلهم ولا فخر.
thaqalaynSanad: Aḥmad b. al-Ḥasan al-Qaṭṭān narrated to us, saying that Aḥmad b. Muḥammad b. al-Saʿīd al-Hamadānī—the client of Banī Hāshim—narrated to him among others, from Jābir b. Yazīd, from Abī’l-Zubayr al-Makkī, from Jābir b. ʿAbd Allāh al-Anṣārī, who narrates:
thaqalaynMatn: “I entered upon the Messenger of Allāh (sws) on the last Friday of the month of Ramaḍān. When he noticed me, he said to me: “O’ Jābir! This is the last Friday of the month of Ramaḍān. Farewell it by saying thus—O’ Allāh, do not let this alone be the last fulfillment of our covenant with You, for if You make it so, then make me liable for mercy and not deprived of it—for whoever says that, then he has triumphed through one of two great ways—either he makes it to the next month of Ramaḍān, or he attains the supreme forgiveness of Allāh and His mercy.” Then he (as) said: “Verily, Allāh (twt) has not made fasting in the month of Ramaḍān a duty on any past peoples except for the Prophets—to the exclusion of their respective communities—and what was made a duty upon the Prophets and Messengers before me has only been made a duty upon you people as an act of honor and esteem. By He Who sent me forth with the Truth, Allāh did not grant anyone of the Prophets a virtue but that He granted it to me, too, while I have been given that which has not been given to them. And I have been favored over them sufficiently, and I am their master, the fairest among them, and their most virtuous one—and I do not say that with (unjustified) pride.”

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: The Report about Farewelling the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us, saying that Makkī b. ʿAbdān informed him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Ḥamūwayh al-Asfazārī narrated to him among others, saying that Muslim b. Ibrāhīm narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAmrū b. Ḥurra al-ʿUbaynī narrated to him among others, saying that Khalaf b. al-Rabīʿ narrated to him among others, from Anas b. Mālik, who narrates: “The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) said: “When the month of Ramaḍān comes—glory be to Allāh!—what is coming to meet you, and what are you going to meet?” He said this thrice. ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb responded: “O’ Messenger of Allāh, has a revelation been made, or is there an enemy present?,” so he replied: “No. Rather, Allāh (azwj) forgives—on the first night of Ramaḍān—all of the people of this Qibla.” Anas b. Mālik continued narrating: “At the end of the throng of people, there was a man who kept shaking his head and saying: “Bakh! Bakh!,” [1] so the Holy Prophet (sawa) said to him: “Has what you heard constricted your chest?,” but the man replied: “No, o’ Messenger of Allāh, but I recalled the hypocrites!” The Holy Prophet (sawa) stated: “Indeed, for the hypocrite—but not for the disbeliever—is a share in this (aforementioned forgiveness).”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو محمد عبد الله بن حامد، قال: أخبرنا مكّي بن عبدان، قال: حدثنا محمد بن حمويه الأسفزاري، قال: حدثنا مسلم بن إبراهيم، قال: حدثنا عمرو بن حرة العبيني، قال: حدثنا خلف بن الربيع، عن أنس بن مالك، قال: قال رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله): لما أحضر شهر رمضان سبحان الله ماذا يستقبلكم وماذا تستقبلون؟ قالها ثلاثاً، فقال عمر بن الخطّاب: يا رسول الله أوحي نزل أو عدو حضر؟ قال: لا ولكن الله عز وجل يغفر في أول ليلة من رمضان لكل أهل هذه القبلة، قال: وفي ناحية القوم رجل يهز رأسه ويقول: بخ بخ، فقال له النبي (صلى الله عليه وآله): ضاق صدرك بما سمعت؟ قال: لا والله يا رسول الله ولكن ذكرت المنافقين، فقال النبي (صلى الله عليه وآله): إن المنافق وليس لكافر فيها شئ.
thaqalaynSanad: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us, saying that Makkī b. ʿAbdān informed him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Ḥamūwayh al-Asfazārī narrated to him among others, saying that Muslim b. Ibrāhīm narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAmrū b. Ḥurra al-ʿUbaynī narrated to him among others, saying that Khalaf b. al-Rabīʿ narrated to him among others, from Anas b. Mālik, who narrates: “The Messenger of Allāh (sawa) said:
thaqalaynMatn: “When the month of Ramaḍān comes—glory be to Allāh!—what is coming to meet you, and what are you going to meet?” He said this thrice. ʿUmar b. al-Khaṭṭāb responded: “O’ Messenger of Allāh, has a revelation been made, or is there an enemy present?,” so he replied: “No. Rather, Allāh (azwj) forgives—on the first night of Ramaḍān—all of the people of this Qibla.” Anas b. category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: The Report about Farewelling the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us, saying that Ḥāmid b. Muḥammad al-Raqā al-Harawī informed him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Yūnus narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. Rajā narrated to him among others, saying that Ḥarīz b. Ayyūb al-Bajalī narrated to him among others, from al-Shaʿbī, from Nāfiʿ b. Bardah, from Ibn Masʿūd, who reports that he heard the Messenger of Allāh (sws) say: “When the month of Ramaḍān arrives, the servants (of Allāh) would wish that it had lasted a whole year, if only they knew what is in Ramaḍān.” So a man—from Khuzāʿa—said: “Narrate to us regarding it, o’ Messenger of Allāh!,” so the Prophet continued: “Verily, Paradise is ornamented from the start of each year to the next until, when it is the first day of the month of Ramaḍān, a wind blows from beneath the Throne, rustling the leaves of Paradise. The celestial maidens (ḥūr al-ʿayn) will see that and say: “O’ Lord! Give to us husbands from among Your servants—in this month—so that they may bless our eyes and we theirs!” There is not a servant who fasts in the month of Ramaḍān but that he will be married to one of the celestial maidens in a pavilion of hollow pearl—as described by Allāh (azwj): ﴾Fair ones reserved in pavilions﴿ [55:72]—and every woman from among them will be dressed in seventy bolts of cloth, none of which resemble others in colour, and seventy hues of perfume, none of which resemble the others in scent. Every woman from among them owns seventy beds of red ruby, woven with pearls, and each bed has seventy mattresses with linings of brocade, and set upon every seventy mattresses are seventy couches. Every woman has seventy thousand male and seventy thousand female servants, each holding a golden platter of various kinds of food—wherein deliciousness is found in a morsel of the last kind that is not found in the first—and her husband will be granted something like that. He will be seated on a bed of red ruby, upon which is a couch of gold woven with red rubies. This is for every day of Ramaḍān spent fasting, besides that which is gained for other good deeds done therein.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو محمد عبد الله بن حامد، قال: أخبرنا حامد بن محمد الرقا الهروي، قال: حدثنا محمد بن يونس، قال: حدثنا عبد الله بن رجا، قال: حدثنا حريز بن أيّوب البجلي، عن الشعبي، عن نافع بن برده، عن ابن مسعود أنه سمع رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) يقول: وقد أهل رمضان لو يعلم العباد ما في رمضان لتمنت أن يكون رمضان سنة، فقال رجل من خزاعة: حدثنا عنه يا رسول الله! قال: إن الجنة تزين من رأس الحول إلى الحول حتى إذا كان أول يوم من شهر رمضان هبت ريح من تحت العرش فصفقت ورق الجنة فينظر حور العين إلى ذلك فيقلن: يا رب اجعل لنا من لدنك عبادك في هذا الشهر أزواجاً تقر أعيننا وتقر أعينهم بنا! فما من عبد يصوم شهر رمضان إلا زوج زوجة من الحور العين في خيمة من در مجوف مما نعت الله عز وجل: ﴿حُورٌۭ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌۭ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ﴾، على كل امرأة منهن سبعون حلة ليس منها حلة على لون الأخرى وسبعون لوناً من الطيب ليس فيها لون على ريح الآخر لكل امرأة منهن سبعين سريراً من ياقوتة حمراء منسوجة بالدر على كل سرير سبعون فراشاً بطائنها من إستبرق فوق السبعين سبعون أريكة لكل امرأة سبعون الف وصيف وسبعون الف وصيفة مع كل وصيف صحفة من ذهب فيها لون من الطعام يجد الآخر لقمة منها لذة لا يجد لأولها ويعطى زوجها مثل ذلك على سرير من ياقوت أحمر عليه سوار من ذهب منسوج بياقوت أحمر، هذا لكل يوم صام من رمضان سوى ما عمل من الحسنات.
thaqalaynSanad: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us, saying that Ḥāmid b. Muḥammad al-Raqā al-Harawī informed him among others, saying that Muḥammad b. Yūnus narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. Rajā narrated to him among others, saying that Ḥarīz b. Ayyūb al-Bajalī narrated to him among others, from al-Shaʿbī, from Nāfiʿ b. Bardah, from Ibn Masʿūd, who reports that he heard the Messenger of Allāh (sws) say:
thaqalaynMatn: “When the month of Ramaḍān arrives, the servants (of Allāh) would wish that it had lasted a whole year, if only they knew what is in Ramaḍān.” So a man—from Khuzāʿa—said: “Narrate to us regarding it, o’ Messenger of Allāh!,” so the Prophet continued: “Verily, Paradise is ornamented from the start of each year to the next until, when it is the first day of the month of Ramaḍān, a wind blows from beneath the Throne, rustling the leaves of Paradise. category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān
chapter: The Report about Farewelling the Month of Ramaḍān
author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥusayn al-Zaʿfarānī informed him among others—in Wāsiṭ (in Iraq)—saying that Ismāʿīl b. Muḥammad narrated to him among others, saying that Ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to him, saying that Hishām informed him among others, from Yaḥyā b. Kathīr, from Abī Salama, from Abī Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allāh (sws) said: “Whoever fasts in the month of Ramaḍān, having faith and seeking its reward, will have forgiveness for whatever has already preceded of his sins.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو محمد عبد الله بن حامد، قال: أخبرنا محمد بن الحسين الزعفراني بواسط، قال: حدثنا إسماعيل بن محمد، قال: حدثني ابن إبراهيم، قال: أخبرنا هشام، عن يحيى، بن كثير، عن أبي سلمة، عن أبي هريرة أن رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم) قال: من صام رمضان إيماناً وإحتساباً غفر له ما تقدم من ذنبه.
thaqalaynSanad: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us, saying that Muḥammad b. al-Ḥusayn al-Zaʿfarānī informed him among others—in Wāsiṭ (in Iraq)—saying that Ismāʿīl b. Muḥammad narrated to him among others, saying that Ibn Ibrāhīm narrated to him, saying that Hishām informed him among others, from Yaḥyā b. Kathīr, from Abī Salama, from Abī Hurayra, that the Messenger of Allāh (sws) said:
thaqalaynMatn: “Whoever fasts in the month of Ramaḍān, having faith and seeking its reward, will have forgiveness for whatever has already preceded of his sins.”

englishText: It was said (by Shaykh al-Ṣadūq) that Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us, saying that Makkī b. ʿAbdān narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. Hāshim narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. Numayr narrated to him among others, from al-Aʿmash, from Abī Ṣāliḥ, from Abī Hurayra, who narrates that the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) has said: “A good deed performed by a son of Ādam is multiplied in value from ten to seven hundred times. arabicText: قال: حدثنا أبو محمد عبد الله بن حامد، قال: حدثنا مكّي بن عبدان، قال: حدثنا عبد الله بن هاشم، قال: حدثنا عبد الله بن نمير، عن الأعمش، عن أبي صالح، عن أبي هريرة، قال: قال رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله): حسنة يعملها ابن آدم تضاعف عشر إلى سبعمائة ضعف يقول الله عز وجل: إلا الصيام هو لي وأنا أجزى به بترك شهوته من أجلي، فرحتان للصائم فرحة عند فطره وفرحة يوم يلقى ربه وخلوف فم الصائم أطيب عند الله من ريح المسك، الصوم جنة.

Hāshim narrated to him among others, saying that ʿAbd Allāh b. Numayr narrated to him among others, from al-Aʿmash, from Abī Ṣāliḥ, from Abī Hurayra, who narrates that the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) has said:

category: The Book of Merits of the Month of Ramaḍān

author: Shaykh Muḥammad b. ʿAlī al-Ṣaduq
englishText: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us, saying that Ḥāmid b. Muḥammad informed him among others, saying that Abū Muslim narrated to him among others, saying that Abū ʿĀṣim narrated to him among others, from al-Ḥajjāj—and he is Ibn Abī ʿUthmān—from al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad b. ʿAlī, from Abī Hurayra, who reports that the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) said: “Three supplications are certainly answered—the supplication of the fasting person, the supplication of the traveller, and the supplication of the oppressed.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو محمد عبد الله بن حامد، قال: أخبرنا حامد بن محمد، قال: حدثنا أبو مسلم، قال: حدثنا أبو عاصم، عن الحجّاج وهو ابن أبي عثمان، عن الحسين عن محمد بن علي، عن أبي هريرة، قال: قال رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله): ثلاث دعوات مستجابات: دعوة الصائم، ودعوة المسافر، ودعوة المظلوم.
thaqalaynSanad: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us, saying that Ḥāmid b. Muḥammad informed him among others, saying that Abū Muslim narrated to him among others, saying that Abū ʿĀṣim narrated to him among others, from al-Ḥajjāj—and he is Ibn Abī ʿUthmān—from al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad b. ʿAlī, from Abī Hurayra, who reports that the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) said:
thaqalaynMatn: “Three supplications are certainly answered—the supplication of the fasting person, the supplication of the traveller, and the supplication of the oppressed.”

englishText: Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd Allāh b. Ḥāmid narrated to us, saying that Ibrāhīm b. Muḥammad b. ʿAbd Allāh informed him among others, saying that Ḥāmid b. Abī ʿAmrū al-Muṭṭalib, from Abī Saʿīd b. Saʿīd al-Muqārrī, from Abī Hurayra, who reports that the Messenger of Allāh (sawa) said: “Many a fasting person’s only gain from his fasting is hunger, and many a praying person’s only gain from his praying (supererogatory prayers at nighttime) is sleeplessness.”
arabicText: حدثنا أبو محمد عبد الله بن حامد، قال: أخبرنا إبراهيم بن محمد بن عبد الله، قال: حدثنا حامد بن شعيب البلخي، قال: حدثنا يحيى بن أيّوب العابد، قال: حدثنا إسماعيل بن جعفر، عن عمرو بن أبي عمرو المطّلب، عن أبي سعيد بن سعيد المقري، عن أبي هريرة، قال: قال رسول الله (صلى الله عليه وآله): رب صائم حظه من صيامه الجوع، ورب قائم حظه من قيامه السهر.
